description:
From the fz-kdt.127 cold review (2026-09-02, F5; env-gated probe over 466
fixtures, reverted). ir_interp/backend.rs materialize_transport_value
(:2410-2424) boxes a Transport-shaped callable (direct layout, capturing)
with the BARE function id as its code word instead of a construction
wrapper id. Census: 32 events on 6 fixtures (mailbox_closure_reduce 9,
mailbox_closure_each 7, enum_predicate_search 6, tailcall_closure_captures
4, opaque_fn_each_discarded_return 4, 00284 2). Bare-fnref mint (:1295)
and bare-lambda mint (:1336): 0 hits. Under fz-kdt.127 (B) such a word
resolves to a shape with no captures -- rejected by capture-bearing arms
(the sound direction; 0 corpus movement) but blind: a construction-shape
question cannot see these values. Fix: name a construction when boxing
(the wrapper for that CallableId exists whenever the value is
first-class; if none exists the boxing itself is the finding). Red-first:
a dispatch on such a value's capture type. Sequence inside or right after
fz-kdt.127's stage (B).

comments.text:
THE BLIND SPOT IS NOW IN THE CODE, at one named site (fz-kdt.127.1,
f34c2aaa3). `ir_interp/backend.rs::backend_callable_identity` answers a
code word that is NOT a construction wrapper with
`CallableShape { target: ClosureTarget(fn_id.0), captures: Vec::new() }`.
A capture-bearing arm shape refuses it on capture-count alone
(`CallableShape::inside` demands equal lengths), which is the sound
direction and moved nothing in the corpus -- 0 behaviour movers over 594
fixtures on three doors -- but a value boxed by
`materialize_transport_value` with a bare function id can never pass a
capture-bearing test, and no diagnostic says so.

The red-first witness this ticket wants is now writable: a dispatch on
the capture type of a value that reaches one of the six fixtures'
`materialize_transport_value` boxing sites.

title: Interp boxes a capturing direct-layout callable with a bare function id: 32 words on 6 fixtures name no construction
